name: window-mirror
description: Mirror one desktop window into a dinotty pane

scripts.build: node -e "require('node:fs').mkdirSync('dist',{recursive:true})" && npm run build:native && npm run copy:native && npm run build:ui
scripts.test: npm run test:native && npm run test:keys && npm run test:rfb && npm run test:input
scripts.build:test-modules: esbuild src/keys.ts --bundle --format=esm --platform=neutral --outfile=dist/keys.mjs && esbuild src/storage-key.ts --bundle --format=esm --platform=neutral --outfile=dist/storage-key.mjs && esbuild src/trackpad.ts --bundle --format=esm --platform=neutral --outfile=dist/trackpad.mjs
scripts.test:keys: npm run build:test-modules && node --test test/keys.test.mjs test/storage-key.test.mjs test/trackpad.test.mjs
